title_en: A Day in the Life of a Delivery Rider
note_en: 不得不 literally means "cannot not," and the double negative adds up to "have no choice but to": 很多骑手不得不争分夺秒 "many riders have no choice but to race against the clock." It is stronger than 要 or 得 (děi) "have to," because it stresses that the situation leaves no alternative. Notice too the four-character idiom 争分夺秒, literally "fight for minutes, seize seconds."
